name: Cheek Texture
algorithm: Cheek Texture — 픽셀 수준 공간 분석
mechanism:
This method analyzes cheek skin texture patterns across video frames for deepfake detection:

1. **Cheek영역추출**: Using facial landmarks, the cheek regions (below the zygomatic bone, lateral to the nose, above the jawline) are precisely segmented per frame. The regions are geometrically normalized to compensate for head pose variations, enabling consistent texture comparison across frames.

2. **Micro-텍스처분석**: High-frequency texture features — pores, fine wrinkles, skin grain, and sebaceous patterns — are extracted using Gabor filters and Local Binary Pattern (LBP) descriptors. Real human cheek skin exhibits a characteristic multi-scale texture hierarchy determined by dermatological structure.

3. **텍스처시간적일관성**: The micro-texture signature of cheek regions is tracked across consecutive frames. In authentic video, skin micro-texture remains stable (pores don't move or disappear between frames). Deepfake generators often produce inconsistent frame-to-frame micro-texture — pores may appear, disappear, or shift position as the generator independently synthesizes each frame.

4. **피부RenderingQuality평가**: The statistical properties of cheek texture (histogram of oriented gradients, spatial frequency distribution) are compared against natural skin models. AI-generated cheeks tend to be either over-smoothed (lacking natural pore detail) or show artificial texture patterns with repetitive structures uncommon in real skin.

5. **조명-Independent텍스처점수 산출**: Texture features are computed in illumination-invariant color spaces to separate genuine texture from illumination effects. The final score quantifies the deviation of cheek texture from expected natural skin characteristics and its temporal stability across frames.
parameters:
분석 유형: 픽셀
미디어: 비디오
입력: Video frames extracted at key intervals
출력: 신뢰도 점수 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 중간~높음 — 70-88% 단독 정확도. Most effective when combined with other 비디오 forensic methods. Performance depends on 비디오 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 비디오 through cheek 텍스트ure analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 비디오 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 비디오 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 비디오 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 비디오 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
